connector.name: dxtra Radio - Frequency Database
connector.registryDescription: Radio frequency database: FM, AM, shortwave, TV, ham, weather, emergency alerts. 15+ countries.
connector.summary: Hosted at dxtra.com over server sent events. No credential is declared, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.dxtra, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
